scholarship_title: DSU Toscana Scholarship and Accommodation 2026/2027 (Bachelor's and Master's)
provider_organization: DSU Toscana (Azienda Regionale per il Diritto allo Studio Universitario della Toscana), Region of Tuscany

stipend.notes: Amount depends on family income and whether the student is local, commuter or off-site. One academic year; reapply every year.

additional_benefits: Housing (university residence place, applied for in the same call)

eligibility_criteria.min_gpa: No merit requirement stated for first-year students; renewal from year 2 depends on credits earned
language_proficiency: None required for the grant itself (programme admission rules apply)

preparation_alerts: Non-EU students need an ISEE parificato: family income and asset documents legalised and translated. Start in spring, months before the deadline.
Apply before the deadline even if not yet enrolled
